verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Mistral serves https://docs.mistral.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It is a structured index that links to markdown (.md) versions of doc pages, and multiple evidence items show it summarizing agent, tool, MCP and model topics. An agent can be pointed directly at it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it, evidence of a full-content variant such as llms-full.txt, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.mistral.ai/llms.txt # MistralAI
